notes: Shift calendar: 'bring up my work shifts' shows a month calendar up to the end of your latest roster; tap a day to give it a shift, mark it off or add a note. 'What am I doing this week?' shows this week in one row. Voice: an Emotion slider in Settings > Voice for every voice (pace, pitch and pauses follow the words), and 14 more adult voices. Roleplay characters can have their own voice and speed.
